subject: Greenlight to extend evaluation window and grant additional credits
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@orbitops.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-01T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short POC extension + extra credits

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the support so far. We hit an internal blocker with our data export pipeline last week and missed a chunk of the evaluation window. Can we get a 3-week extension on the POC and an additional 200k tokens of evaluation credit so our ML team can finish the validation?

We’re trying to avoid pausing the pilot — procurement also asked whether this will trigger any billing or PO requirements. If you can confirm in writing what you can offer (and any conditions), I’ll push this through with our procurement and CSM.

Attaching a short notes PDF showing the export errors.

Thanks,
Emma Li
Head of ML Platforms
OrbitOps, Inc.

Attachment: OrbitOps_Eval_Failures.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-01T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short POC extension + extra credits

Emma —

Appreciate the note and the report — sorry to hear about the export issues. I can escalate to get an exception to our standard PLG evaluation limits, but I need to run the ask by Deal Desk / Markus for signoff because it’s outside the standard 14-day/100k token allowance.

Quick asks from our side to help the approval:
- Confirm expected conversion timeline if the extension is granted (target month for decision).
- Expected first-year ARR if you move to a committed plan (ballpark is fine).
- Will procurement require a formal PO for the extension or would a short addendum be enough?

If you can reply with those two bullets I’ll put together an internal memo for Markus.

—Vanessa

Subject: Fwd: Request: short POC extension + extra credits — request for exception

Markus / Ben —

Forwarding a request from OrbitOps (mid-market prospect, good fit for our dedicated tier later this year). They missed part of their eval window due to a data export failure and are asking for: 1) +200k tokens of eval credit; 2) a 3-week extension beyond our standard PLG allowance.

Context:
- ARR potential (sales estimate): ~$180k ARR first-year if pilot converts.
- Product fit: clear; engineering already integrated streaming endpoints.
- Risk: low but they want a formal written confirmation to procurement.

Proposed limited exception (my recommendation):
- Grant 150,000 tokens (one-time, non-recurring eval grant).
- Approve a 2-week extension from their current expiry (shorter than requested).
- Require CSM handoff and a committed conversion milestone: if no signed PO or committed plan by 2028-06-30, no further credits.
- Require procurement to ACK terms by providing a PO number or signing a one-page addendum (we can DocuSign).

If you’re okay with the proposed bounds I’ll confirm with OrbitOps. Otherwise flag what you want changed.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Approve the conservative path. Grant 150k tokens and a 2-week extension only. From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Emma Li <emma@orbitops.com>, procure@orbitops.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-03T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: Eval extension + one-time credits (conditional)

Emma —

Thanks for the details. We reviewed internally and can approve a limited exception. Summary of what Redwood will provide: 

1) One-time grant of 150,000 evaluation tokens (non-recurring).
2) A 14-day (2 week) extension to your current evaluation window, starting from your current expiry date.
3) Conditions: CSM engagement (I’ve looped in Ben to coordinate), and a conversion milestone — a signed PO or documented commit in HubSpot by 2028-06-30. If those are not met, no additional credits or extensions will be provided.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached a short addendum outlining the terms and an instructions PDF for how procurement can provide a PO number or sign via DocuSign. Please confirm with procurement which route you prefer.
- Ben (cc) will reach out to schedule a CSM sync this week.

Attachments: Signed-PO-Instructions.pdf, Eval-Terms-Addendum.docx

If that works, we’ll send the credits and confirm new expiry once we have procurement acknowledgement.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
